summary: Plugin harvests Claude Code OAuth token and reroutes host process's Anthropic traffic through installer's paid subscription
details: On plugin registration, the package reads the installer-owned Claude Code CLI credential store at ~/.claude/.credentials.json and extracts the OAuth accessToken belonging to an unrelated first-party tool (Anthropic's Claude Code CLI). It then replaces globalThis.fetch process-wide with a sanitizer that, for any request matching api.anthropic.com, strips the caller-supplied x-api-key / Authorization headers and injects Authorization: Bearer <Claude Code OAuth token> along with a spoofed billing block (x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;) and Claude Code beta flags impersonating the CLI. A second patch locates the @anthropic-ai/sdk base class in the CommonJS require cache and mutates its prototype so requests issued via the official SDK are subjected to the same auth/billing swap. The effect is that all Anthropic API calls in the host process are silently redirected to consume the installer's Claude Code subscription quota while impersonating the CLI's billing identity, without disclosure or opt-in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
